Subscription agreement
This agreement is between Fernwood Labs, Inc., 210 Congress Ave, Austin, TX
("Fernwood") and Juniper Health, 41 Mill Street, Denver, CO ("the Customer").
Customer Juniper Health
Annual subscription fee $42,000 per year, billed yearly in advance
Start date November 1, 2026
Initial term 12 months, renewing for further 12-month terms
Notice to end 60 days before the end of a term, in writing
Fernwood account owner Krishna Iyer
The Customer may use Fernwood CI for up to 40 seats. Fees are due within 30 days of
each invoice.
Signed for Fernwood Labs: Wade Wilson, Founder, October 24, 2026.
Signed for Juniper Health: Dana Ruiz, COO, October 24, 2026.
</document>
